description: Jev 1.14 (`jev-1.14.0`) is TypeSafe AI's newest Jev release, available from October 14, 2026. It is served by the same vendor-native endpoint `POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` as the rest of the Jev family. It does not generate text: a caller posts a `state` plus a map of typed questions (Choice / Score / Noul) and gets back one typed decision per question, each with a calibrated probability and a confidence value that application code branches on. Input is text only; default context is 64k tokens per request (`state` plus all questions combined) and 32k for `state` plus the single longest question. `outputModalities` reads `text` because the catalog modality vocabulary has no token for typed structured values; the model emits no free-form string.
